_comment: Centralized development configuration for the Mehua Lashes deposit-concierge prototype. This is the canonical source of truth for these values — edit here first. The n8n workflow embeds a copy of this object in each 'Load Mehua Config' node (n8n has no clean cross-branch config include without an Execute Workflow sub-node, which isn't set up yet — see workflows/README.md). Keep those copies in sync with this file until that's fixed.

deposit._status: CONFIRMED: amount=500 MUR, method=Juice, payment_details=5902 8505 (MCB Juice) — provided directly by Joshua. This is the existing manual Juice number already given out to customers; not a secret/PIN/OTP. Keep this file private (already git-ignored from any public sync) but it is fine to be present in this private repo.

deposit_policy: The deposit of Rs 500 is to book your spot and is non-refundable.
cancellation_policy: Cancellations can be done before 48h of the session.
_reminder_timing_status: CONFIRMED by owner: 48h escalation window. 20h resend cooldown is still our own assumption (unconfirmed) to avoid spamming the owner with a reminder every 4-hour check cycle.
_payment_status_rule: Only an explicit owner action (the 'Owner Form - Review Deposit Verification' form, Verification Result = Verified) may move a booking into DEPOSIT_VERIFIED. No OCR, AI model, screenshot analysis or text recognition may ever set this status. Receiving a screenshot only moves a booking to AWAITING_MANUAL_VERIFICATION, never DEPOSIT_VERIFIED directly.

templates._status: CONFIRMED FINAL by owner. Real customer-facing wording — safe to send. Merge fields use {{double_braces}} and are filled by the workflow's own renderTemplate() code, not by n8n's expression engine.
templates.deposit_request_template:
Hi {{customer_name}}! Your appointment for {{service}} on {{booking_date}} at {{booking_time}} has been received.
A deposit of Rs {{deposit_amount}} via {{payment_method}} is required to secure your booking.
{{payment_method}} payment details: {{juice_payment_details}}
Once you've made the payment, please send your payment screenshot here.
Your booking will only be confirmed after the payment has been manually verified.
templates.deposit_reminder_template:
Hi {{customer_name}}, just a reminder that the Rs {{deposit_amount}} {{payment_method}} deposit for your appointment on {{booking_date}} at {{booking_time}} is still pending.
Payment details:
{{juice_payment_details}}
Please send your payment screenshot after payment so the booking can be verified.

test_scenario._status: Development/test fixture only. Never represents a real customer, real Juice transaction, real Gmail inbox, or real WhatsApp account.
